# form representation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:formRepresentation`](gmeow-formRepresentation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/formRepresentation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The actual string or value of a lexical form — the written text, IPA transcription, sign notation, or reconstructed string. Functional: one representation per form instance (a different representation is a different form).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:LexicalForm`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalForm.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:formRepresentation`](gmeow-formRepresentation.md) from [`gmeow:LexicalForm`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalForm.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the actual surface string of a lexical form — its written text, IPA transcription, sign notation, or reconstructed shape.

### Avoid when

- Avoid giving one form two representations (it is functional; a different string is a different form) and avoid storing the form-kind here (that is [`gmeow:formType`](gmeow-formType.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:formRepresentation`](gmeow-formRepresentation.md) once per [`gmeow:LexicalForm`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalForm.md) with the surface literal; carry the modality via [`gmeow:formType`](gmeow-formType.md) and any transliteration scheme via [`gmeow:formTransliterationScheme`](gmeow-formTransliterationScheme.md).

### Examples

- ex:waterIpa [`gmeow:formRepresentation`](gmeow-formRepresentation.md) "ˈwɔːtə".
